title: Halloumi Three-Bean Salad with Pomegranate-Harissa Vinaigrette
description: Pan-fried halloumi, 3 types of beans, red onion, fresh coriander, and mint are tossed with homemade vinaigrette for a unique salad your taste buds will love.
ingredients: 7 ounces halloumi cheese, cut into 1-inch slabs
1.5 teaspoons harissa, or more to taste
1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup white beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Cook each halloumi slab on all 4 sides, about 5 minutes. Set aside and allow to cool slightly; cut into 1/4-inch cubes.
While cheese is cooking, whisk pomegranate vinegar, honey, harissa, olive oil, and black pepper together in a dressing jar. Set aside.

Combine black beans, kidney beans, white beans, onion, mint, and cilantro in a bowl and toss with a spoon. Add cooked halloumi. Drizzle vinaigrette dressing over salad and toss to coat. Cover and allow to sit at room temperature at least 15 minutes.
